heading: What it is
content: 246 production-ready Claude Code skills, plugins, and agent skills for 12 AI coding tools, from c10vis-poem/claude-skills (fork of alirezarezvani/claude-skills). Works natively as Claude Code plugins, Codex agent skills, Gemini CLI skills, converts to 8 more tools via scripts/convert.sh. Each skill is a folder with SKILL.md plus optional scripts/ (305 stdlib-only Python CLI tools), references/, assets/.

heading: Skills vs Agents vs Personas
content: Skills = how to execute a task (single domain, neutral voice). Agents = what task to do (single domain, professional voice). Personas = who is thinking (cross-domain, personality-driven). All three combine via the Orchestration patterns.

heading: 246 skills across 9 domains
content: Engineering-Core (32): architecture, frontend, backend, fullstack, QA, DevOps, SecOps, AI/ML, data, Playwright, self-improving agent, security suite, a11y audit. Playwright Pro (9+3): test generation, flaky fix, Cypress/Selenium migration, TestRail, BrowserStack. Self-Improving Agent (5+2): auto-memory curation, pattern promotion, skill extraction. Engineering-POWERFUL (40): agent designer, RAG architect, database designer, CI/CD builder, security auditor, MCP builder, llm-wiki, reliability portfolio, ship-gate. Product (13): PM, agile PO, UX researcher, SaaS scaffolder, code-to-prd. Marketing (44): 7 pods (Content/SEO/CRO/Channels/Growth/Intelligence/Sales). Project Management (9): senior PM, scrum master, Jira/Confluence/Atlassian. Regulatory & QM (14): ISO 13485, MDR, FDA, ISO 27001, GDPR, SOC 2. C-Level Advisory (28): full C-suite plus orchestration. Business & Growth (5). Finance (3): DCF/budgeting, SaaS metrics coach.

heading: Note: llm-wiki skill exists in the POWERFUL tier
content: The Engineering-POWERFUL tier includes a skill literally named llm-wiki, the same concept name as the LLM Wiki research doc (Karpathy 3-layer framework: raw sources / AI-generated wiki / schema file) that originally kicked off this Claude_master_wiki project. UNVERIFIED whether this skill implements the same methodology or is a coincidental name match -- worth a direct diff if the wiki-building pipeline is ever automated with Claude Code skills directly.

heading: 25 POWERFUL-tier advanced skills
content: agent-designer, agent-workflow-designer, rag-architect, database-designer, database-schema-designer, migration-architect, skill-security-auditor (scans skills for malicious code before install -- command injection, code execution, data exfiltration, prompt injection, supply-chain risk, privilege escalation; returns PASS/WARN/FAIL), ci-cd-pipeline-builder, mcp-server-builder (OpenAPI to MCP scaffold), pr-review-expert, api-design-reviewer, api-test-suite-builder, dependency-auditor, release-manager, observability-designer, performance-profiler, monorepo-navigator, changelog-generator, codebase-onboarding, runbook-generator, git-worktree-manager, env-secrets-manager, incident-commander, tech-debt-tracker, interview-system-designer.

heading: Personas
content: Pre-configured agent identities with curated skill loadouts and distinct communication styles: Startup CTO (engineering+strategy), Growth Marketer (content-led growth, launch strategy), Solo Founder (cross-domain, one-person startups, MVP building).

heading: Orchestration patterns
content: Four patterns for combining personas/skills/agents: Solo Sprint (switch personas across project phases), Domain Deep-Dive (one persona plus multiple stacked skills), Multi-Agent Handoff (personas review each other's output), Skill Chain (sequential skills, no persona needed).

heading: Install patterns
content: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add alirezarezvani/claude-skills then /plugin install <domain>-skills@claude-code-skills for per-domain bundles, or individual skills. Also supports Gemini CLI (scripts/gemini-install.sh), OpenAI Codex (npx agent-skills-cli add ... --agent codex), OpenClaw (curl installer), manual copy to ~/.claude/skills/.

heading: Relevance to this project
content: Largest ready-made skills catalog available to fork into Omni Claw/Novus Agenti's skill system. Two entries matter most: skill-security-auditor (relevant if Omni Claw ever lets a background agent install skills autonomously -- provides a PASS/WARN/FAIL gate before trusting a skill folder) and mcp-server-builder (OpenAPI to MCP scaffold -- could accelerate wiring OB1's remote MCP or new Omni Claw tool endpoints). The non-engineering domains (marketing, finance, C-level, regulatory) are lower priority for an on-device coding assistant but available if scope broadens.
